tools.name: files_search
tools.description: Search text/log files under an allowed folder for lines containing a phrase (case-insensitive, plain text, not a regex). Optionally keep only lines whose leading timestamp falls between from and to.

tools.name: files_tail
tools.description: Read the last lines of one text/log file inside an allowed folder.

tools.name: files_recent_changes
tools.description: List files under an allowed folder that were modified at or after a time, newest first.

tools.name: files_disk_space
tools.description: Free and used space on the drive that holds an allowed folder.

tools.name: files_check
tools.description: Check one file or folder inside an allowed folder: whether it exists, its size and modified time, and whether it can be read and written.

tools.name: deploys_recent
tools.description: List deployments and commits for a service (or every service when service is omitted) between from and to, newest first.

tools.name: deploys_change_summary
tools.description: Show what one deployment or commit changed for a service: changed files with line counts and a short patch.

tools.name: metrics_list
tools.description: List the metric names available for a service.

tools.name: metrics_series
tools.description: Read one metric for a service between from and to, with its baseline (first value), peak and when the peak happened.

tools.name: metrics_host
tools.description: Current CPU, memory and uptime of the machine this server runs on (a point-in-time reading, not history).

runbooks.title: Runbook: payment-api database connectivity
runbooks.body: When payment-api reports database connection timeouts: 1) Check DB connection pool utilization (in_use vs max) on payment-api pods. 2) Check database availability, CPU and active connections on payments-db. 3) Compare the effective max connection / pool size configuration with the last healthy deployment. 4) Review differences from the last healthy deployment before rolling back.
